claim: Provided reproduction data support stable validation clusters Na13@Rb32, K13@Cs42, and Ag13@Cu45.
Adjacent-shell optimal mismatches cluster into low MC->MC (~0.04), intermediate MC->Ch1 (~0.136-0.14), and larger Ch1->Ch2 (~0.21) regimes.
Theoretical and measured mismatch validation points agree closely.
Growth summaries show conservative MC growth, seeded Ch1 convergence, and a mixed Ag/Cu transition toward Ch1-like mismatch.
Conservative path choices dominate the recorded path-selection statistics.
